name: Zero Watch
office_task: Every Monday, list each account in the client's ledger that should sit at zero but doesn't, with its balance from the ledger's own balance sheet and its oldest unexplained line.
systems_of_record: the client's ledger (Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks Online), read over the AI Pathway hosted MCP (connect.aipathway.com.au) through the business's own sign-in: the balance of each named account from the ledger's own balance sheet as at the Sunday the week ends, and the account's transactions for the age of its oldest line not matched to an offsetting line. It only reads: it never posts a clearing journal, and any write a person later wants goes through the Ledger Write Preview standard
the definitions register the bookkeeper or practice keeps (a sheet or list): each account that should sit at zero, named once by its code, with its owner
the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the week's zero watch per audience (the client's bookkeeper, the reviewing partner): each named account's balance from the ledger's balance sheet, and for the bookkeeper the age of its oldest unexplained line, each figure carrying its definition id, source and as-of time, with the commentary naming every account as at zero or not at zero; a balance that cannot be read is published as unavailable with the reason; a correction is a new version superseding the old, with the named person and the reason
emits.readback: reading the week's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and report.publish_failed is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a ledger read that got no answer, an account the register does not name or names twice, a threshold that could not be compared, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the week, the account, the reason and the exception_owner
